description: This file defines cache management classes and utilities for the Superset project, including custom cache subclasses that handle hashing algorithms and cache initialization logic.

classes.name: ConfigurableHashMethod
classes.description: A callable that defers hash algorithm selection to runtime based on app configuration.

classes.name: SupersetCache
classes.description: A subclass of Flask-Caching's Cache that uses a configurable hash method for cache key generation.

classes.name: ExploreFormDataCache
classes.description: A specialized cache class for explore form data, with custom get method to handle cache key renaming.

classes.name: CacheManager
classes.description: Manages multiple cache instances and their initialization, including signal cache setup.

methods.name: ConfigurableHashMethod.__call__
methods.description: Creates a hash object using the algorithm specified in app config.

methods.name: SupersetCache.memoize
methods.description: Overrides the memoize method to use the configurable hash method.

methods.name: SupersetCache.cached
methods.description: Overrides the cached method to use the configurable hash method.

methods.name: ExploreFormDataCache.get
methods.description: Retrieves cache data and renames keys for compatibility with new data models.

methods.name: CacheManager._init_cache
methods.description: Initializes a cache instance based on app configuration, with fallback and warning logic.

methods.name: CacheManager._init_signal_cache
methods.description: Initializes the signal cache backend for pub/sub and distributed locks.

methods.name: CacheManager.init_app
methods.description: Initializes all caches for the application.
